blocks.html: Speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village.

blocks.html: Squeeze through the loose railing to the west.

blocks.html: Climb down ladder to the east.

substeps.html: If you no longer have a key from the Waterfall Quest, go to the east side of the cave and search the off-colour crate to get one.

blocks.html: Use the key on the northern gate.

blocks.html: Search the chest to obtain crystalline discs.

blocks.html: Push the small monolith south.

blocks.html: Push the north-west monolith west.

blocks.html: Open the mahogany chest, then search it to obtain the strongroom key.

blocks.html: Push the south-east monolith west and open the western gate.
